name: smwgraphics-super-paper-mario-castle-bleck
title: Super Paper Mario - Castle Bleck
description:
Count Bleck's castle from Super Paper Mario. Includes pretty much everything the original game had.

If you want to use the layer 3 fog background in conjunction with the foreground, it's advised to activate layer 2 and use the provided arch tiles on that layer to give your level a better style (see screenshots).
Also, changing block palettes to match the palette makes the level more coherent (see screenshots).

ExGFX slots are as follows:
ExGFX88 ---> FG3
ExGFX89 ---> BG2
ExGFX8A ---> BG3
ExGFX18A ---> LG2
ExGFX188 ---> LG3
ExGFX189 ---> LG4
ExGFX18B ---> LT3

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)
